title: PHP 8. Swap two values. What does this print?
explain: The right side is built first: [2, 1]. Then [$a, $b] = ... takes the values out in order. This is array destructuring and it swaps without a temp variable.

title: What does Node print?
explain: JS puts integer-like keys first, in number order. Other keys follow in the order you added them. So the result is 1,2,b,a. Do not depend on key order for text keys with numbers. Use a Map or an array when the order matters.

title: You are in the middle of work and want to see what colleagues pushed, without changing your files. Which command?
options: git fetch, then git log HEAD..origin/main
explain: git fetch only downloads the new commits into origin/main. Your branch and files stay as they are. Then you can look with git log HEAD..origin/main. git pull is fetch plus merge, so it changes your files. reset --hard would delete your work.
